title: 讠 speech (言字旁)
intro: 讠 is the simplified left-side form of 言 (words). It has only two strokes: a dot, then a horizontal that turns down and hooks up. Characters with 讠 are about speaking, language, reading and study. When 言 sits elsewhere it keeps its full form, as in 信 and 警.

texts.title: 读一读 · 讠 speech (言字旁)

lines.zh: 我在北京的一个语言学校学汉语。
lines.p: wǒ zài běi jīng de yī gè yǔ yán xué xiào xué hàn yǔ

lines.zh: 每天上午我们有四节课。
lines.p: měi tiān shàng wǔ wǒ men yǒu sì jiē kè

lines.zh: 我们的老师很认真，说话也很清楚。
lines.p: wǒ men de lǎo shī hěn rèn zhēn shuō huà yě hěn qīng chu

lines.zh: 下课以后，我常常去图书馆读书、查词典、记生词。
lines.p: xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ cháng cháng qù tú shū guǎn dú shū zhā cí diǎn jì shēng cí
wǎn shang wǒ yòng hàn yǔ xiě rì jì

lines.zh: 下个星期有考试，我得好好复习。
lines.p: xià gè xīng qī yǒu kǎo shì wǒ de hǎo hǎo fù xí
